text: With the focus of the Clan, doses of poppy seeds, juniper bunches, mallow, thyme bundles, cobwebs, goldenrod, rosemary clumps, burdock roots, ragwort, daisies, tansy, betony, horsetail clumps, elder leaf bundles, wild garlic, moss clumps, oak leaf bundles, dandelions, plantain bundles, marigold, and lungwort were gathered.
At the Gathering, Yewstar asks VoleClan's leader a few questions about themselves. (VoleClan relations improved.)
RiverClan is prepared for a fight when they find Luna. Luna quickly realizes the odds are not in his favor and flees. The RiverClan cats snarl threats at his back.
